sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM mov_venda
SELECT sum(vlr_tot) AS total FROM mov_venda
SELECT to_char(dt_mov, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(vlr_tot) AS total FROM mov_venda GROUP BY 1
SELECT l.nm_loja AS loja, sum(v.vlr_tot) AS total FROM mov_venda v JOIN loja l ON l.cd_loja = v.cd_loja GROUP BY 1
SELECT l.nm_loja AS loja, count(*) AS n FROM mov_venda v JOIN loja l ON l.cd_loja = v.cd_loja GROUP BY 1
SELECT p.ds_prod AS produto, sum(i.vlr_tot_it) AS total FROM mov_venda_item i JOIN produto p ON p.cd_prod = i.cd_prod GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT d.ds_depto AS departamento, sum(i.vlr_tot_it) AS total FROM mov_venda_item i JOIN produto p ON p.cd_prod = i.cd_prod JOIN departamento d ON d.cd_depto = p.cd_depto GROUP BY 1
SELECT avg(vlr_tot) AS ticket_medio FROM mov_venda
SELECT l.nm_loja AS loja, avg(v.vlr_tot) AS ticket_medio FROM mov_venda v JOIN loja l ON l.cd_loja = v.cd_loja GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cliente
SELECT uf, count(*) AS n FROM cliente GROUP BY 1
SELECT d.ds_depto AS departamento, count(*) AS n FROM produto p JOIN departamento d ON d.cd_depto = p.cd_depto GROUP BY 1

pergunta: Faturamento por mês da Loja Centro
sql: SELECT to_char(v.dt_mov, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(v.vlr_tot) AS total FROM mov_venda v JOIN loja l ON l.cd_loja = v.cd_loja WHERE l.nm_loja = 'Loja Centro' GROUP BY 1
SELECT sum(vlr_tot) AS total FROM mov_venda WHERE dt_mov >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND dt_mov < DATE '2026-04-01'

pergunta: Quantidade de itens vendidos por mês
sql: SELECT to_char(v.dt_mov, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(i.qtd_it) AS itens FROM mov_venda_item i JOIN mov_venda v ON v.nr_cupom = i.nr_cupom GROUP BY 1
SELECT l.uf, sum(v.vlr_tot) AS total FROM mov_venda v JOIN loja l ON l.cd_loja = v.cd_loja GROUP BY 1
SELECT l.nm_loja AS loja, sum(v.vlr_tot) AS total FROM mov_venda v JOIN loja l ON l.cd_loja = v.cd_loja GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

pergunta: Qual o custo médio dos produtos?
sql: SELECT avg(vlr_custo) AS custo_medio FROM produto

pergunta: Quantas vendas não têm cliente identificado?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM mov_venda WHERE cd_cli IS NULL
SELECT avg(n) AS media_itens FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM mov_venda_item GROUP BY nr_cupom) q
